fixture.minimum_safe_rule: Finalization requires current repository authority plus an exact current identity-to-domain mapping and a terminal proof matching that mapping generation/domain. Any retained predecessor proof must be generation-bound historical provenance under a monotonic supersession edge and can never become eligible merely because an execution-domain label later repeats.

A monotonic supersession edge converts predecessor proofs to provenance without requiring hosted coordination or richer-mode arbitration.
